changed_in.5.2: Negative indices begin naming the extra arguments a variadic call received, so one of them can be replaced before the function reads it; earlier versions name nothing there and are answered with `nil`. This is also where the two halves of the pair stop matching: `debug.getlocal()` begins accepting a function value in place of a level from here, and this call never has.
changed_in.5.3: A level or an index carrying a fraction is refused rather than being cut down to a whole number, and so is one too large to hold an exact whole-number value.
